## Description
Onboard the **kill-me** slot chart (`k8s/`) to Glimmung's generic **live-preview** lane (Stage 4b of glimmung `docs/live-preview-plan.md`). The slot chart now optionally hosts the generic `live-preview-edge` in front of kill-me's own stable backend on a preview lease, **gated OFF by default** so nothing changes until Glimmung provisions a preview. The faithful image-deploy / validation lane is untouched; the retired hot-swap stays dead (no hot-swap vocabulary introduced).

## Type of Change
- [x] Infrastructure change

## Changes Made
- **`k8s/values.yaml`** — add `livePreview` block (`enabled: false`; edge image with an empty `tag` Glimmung `--set`s at provision; `upstream.url: http://127.0.0.1:3000`; `backendPrefixes`; `authorizedSubject`; override emptyDir).
- **`k8s/templates/helpers.tpl`** — `kill-me.appPortName`: backend port name stays `http` when off, flips to `app-internal` when the edge fronts it (keeps the disabled render byte-identical).
- **`k8s/templates/deployment.yaml`** — backend container port becomes the named app port (number `3000` unchanged); probes follow the name; `live-preview-edge.container` + `.volume` included **gated** on `livePreview.enabled`; `replicas` via `live-preview-edge.replicas` (single serving pod), the include **gated** so the chart renders standalone without the vendored library.
- **`k8s/templates/service.yaml`** — `targetPort` flips to the edge's served port when enabled (else `http`), the include **gated** for standalone render.
- **`k8s/.gitignore`** — ignore `charts/`: Glimmung vendors the partial at provision time (cluster ConfigMap), it is **not** a committed copy and **not** a Helm dependency.

This mirrors glimmung's dogfood reference `glimmung/k8s/issue`, adapted to kill-me's single-container `http:3000` backend. Because kill-me renders standalone without the library (cross-repo: no committed partial), the `live-preview-edge.replicas` / `.servedPortName` includes are gated on `livePreview.enabled` (glimmung's same-repo chart can call them unconditionally; kill-me cannot).

**Auth:** the edge validates pushes via auth.romaine.life **JWKS** (public RS256 keys fetched over HTTPS — confirmed in glimmung `internal/auth/romaine_jwt.go` + `internal/livepreview/edge.go`). It needs only outbound HTTPS to auth.romaine.life, which the slot pod already has. **No projected SA token is added to the slot pod.**

## Testing
- [x] Tested locally
- [x] Workflow passes

`helm template` (helm v3.16.3), plus `helm lint`, `check-image-fingerprint-config.mjs`, and `check-removed-msal.mjs` — all green.

## Feature Contracts

Affected contracts:
- [x] Faithful validation/image-deploy lane untouched — with `livePreview.enabled=false` (the default) the slot chart renders functionally identical to before.
  Evidence: `helm template` before vs after, comments+blanks stripped, is byte-identical for both the normal/prod render and the warm validation-slot render (`renderMode=warm`). Diff of rendered values: empty. The only textual delta is explanatory YAML comments (ignored by Kubernetes).
- [x] Live-preview edge wired correctly and inactive-until-provisioned — the edge appears only when Glimmung sets `livePreview.enabled=true` on a preview lease; the change alone changes nothing.
  Evidence: enabled render (`livePreview.enabled=true`, partial vendored locally then removed before commit) shows: single replica; app backend port renamed `app-internal` (containerPort `3000` unchanged, probes follow); edge container present with `LIVE_PREVIEW_EDGE_UPSTREAM=http://127.0.0.1:3000`, `BACKEND_PREFIXES=/api,/health`, listen `:8080`; Service `targetPort` resolves to the edge's `http` port; `live-preview-override` emptyDir present. Empty `image.tag` while enabled fails the render loudly; enabled render without the vendored library fails loudly (proves no committed copy / no Helm dependency).
- [x] No retired hot-swap surface reintroduced.
  Evidence: `git diff | grep -iE 'apply_test_slot_hot_swap|artifact_kind|fidelity_classifier|test_slot_hot_swap|GLIMMUNG_HOT_SWAP|resolveArtifact|DispatchHotSwap|hot.?swap'` → no matches. Only `live_preview` / `static_override` vocabulary used.

## Related Issues
Stage 4b of glimmung `docs/live-preview-plan.md` (live frontend preview lane). Hub-orchestrated (tank session 1200).

## Deployment Notes
INACTIVE until Glimmung provisions a preview lease. After merge, the hub applies kill-me's `live_preview` project metadata via Glimmung:
`{ enabled: true, backend_prefixes: ["/api", "/health"], backend_port: 3000 }`.
